text:
margaret: Quick ping  reporter from Wired DM'd asking for a short methods blurb and a 1-line quote for the benchmark post. Deadline ~30m. Who can draft?
press_ops: I can handle. Do we have a concise methods sentence we can share immediately?
harry_legal: Straight facts about hardware and cache settings are ok to share quickly. Avoid comparative language or percentages.
kevin_eng: Shareable methods: 'Benchmarks executed on Dedicated (NVIDIA A100 series), P99 latency measured over 1,000 sampled tokenized requests; baseline runs had KV-prefix cache disabled; q4f16 quantization applied.'
margaret: Good. For the quote keep it non-comparative, one sentence. Draft: 'These benchmarks illustrate how serving choices  batching, cache policy, and quantization  influence latency and cost in production.'
tanya_social: Social-ready short: 'New benchmark: see how serving choices shape latency & cost for real apps. short.redwood/bench'
harry_legal: Approved both as-is.
press-monitor-bot: Media ping logged for Wired  monitoring link https://wired.example/draft-redwood-bench
press_ops: Sent methods blurb + reporter quote. Asked for 30m hold, they confirmed. Adding to media tracker now.
tanya_social: Queued social post for T+10; confirming hero image with ops.
margaret: Thanks team. Post-action: we'll create a one-paragraph fast-quote playbook to speed this up next time. I'll draft tomorrow. :memo:
